2:learn:1.title: Teacher’s Activity
2:learn:1.instruction:
1. Show pictures with short “a” name.
2. Ask learner/s to name the picture.
3. Teacher sound out or blend the sample word/s.
b + a + t= bat c + a + t= cat

2:learn:2.instruction: The teacher will present and read the following words, then ask the learners to sound out the given sample words with the short ‘a’ sound. (This can be done individually, in pairs, by row, or in groups.)

2:learn:3.instruction: Build a word out from the picture. Say it. Connect it. Write it on the blank.

2:learn:4.instruction: Teacher read the words and let learners identify the word that doesn’t belong.

2:learn:5.title: Activity 3: Tell me the Word
2:learn:5.instruction: The teacher shows a picture. The learner says the CVC word that matches the picture.

2:learn:6.instruction: The teacher flashes word cards, and the learners read them quickly. The teacher may include variation activities.

7:learn:1.title: Teacher’s Activity
7:learn:1.instruction:
1. Teacher will introduce the words and show picture.
meal pail
2. Ask the learners to read the names of the pictures
that contain the vowel teams “ea” and “ai.”

7:learn:2.instruction: Present the words. Read each word aloud and let the learners repeat after you. Provide guidance and correct their pronunciation when necessary. meal hear meat seat peak bait nail pail tail rain

7:learn:3.title: Station 1: Word Sorting Worksheet
7:learn:3.instruction: Sort the words into the correct word family columns.

7:learn:4.title: Station 2: Listen & Match Worksheet
7:learn:4.instruction: Teacher: Read each word aloud twice. Learner: Write the number under each picture that matches the word. Words: 1. nail   2. rain   3. tail   4. pail   5. hair   6. meal   7. meat   8. seat   9. peak   10. hear

7:learn:5.title: Station 3: Blend & Say Worksheet
7:learn:5.instruction: Build, blend, and say each word aloud. Complete the word: Example: m + aid = maid

12:learn:1.title: Teacher’s Activity
12:learn:1.instruction:
1. Show pictures with consonant bl- and br-.
2. Ask any learner/s who can blend the |bl-| and
|br-|. If none, the teacher will demonstrate
the blending.
b + l = bl b + r = br
3. Ask another learner/s who can blend the
|bl-| and |br| sounds. If no volunteer,
the teacher will demonstrate the activity.
bl + ue = blue br + ead = bread

12:learn:2.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the missing blend (bl-, br-).

12:learn:3.instruction: Each learner will take turns throwing a pin at the dart board and read aloud the word where the pin lands.

13:learn:1.title: Teacher’s Activity
13:learn:1.instruction:
1. Show pictures with consonant cl- and cr-.
2. Ask any learner/s who can blend the |cl-| and |cr-|. If
none, the teacher will demonstrate the blending.
c + l = cl c + r = cr
3. Ask any learner/s who can blend the |cl-| and |cr-|
sounds. If no volunteer, the teacher will
demonstrate the activity.
cl + ip = clip cr + y = cry

13:learn:2.instruction: Teacher will let the learners read more words with |cl- | and |cr-| blends.

13:learn:3.instruction: Throw a pin at the dart board, name the picture you hit, and tell whether it begins with the consonant blend cl- or cr-.

13:learn:4.instruction: Match each picture with the correct word by drawing a line connecting them.

13:post:4.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the missing blends.

13:post:5.instruction: Match the pictures with the correct cl- and cr- blend. The first one has been done as an example.

14:learn:1.title: Teacher’s Activity
14:learn:1.instruction:
1. Show pictures with consonant dr-.
2. Ask any learner/s who can blend the |dr-|.
If none, the teacher will demonstrate the
blending.
d + r = dr
3. Ask any learner/s who can blend the |dr-| sounds.
If no volunteer, the teacher will demonstrate the
activity.
dr + one = drone

14:learn:2.instruction: Teacher will let the learners read more words with |dr-| blends.

14:learn:3.instruction: Students will act as tourist guides by identifying and leading the teacher to specific 'dr-' blend 'countries' illustrated on the large floor word map.

14:learn:4.instruction: Match each picture with the correct word by drawing a line connecting them.

14:post:2.instruction: Match the dr words to the correct picture.

3. Ask any
learner/s who can blend the |fl-| and |fr-| sounds. If
no volunteer, the teacher will demonstrate the
activity.

15:learn:2.instruction: Teacher will let the learners read more words with |fl-| and |fr-| blends.

15:learn:3.instruction: Color the word/s in each row that begins with fl- or fr- sound and read them.

15:learn:4.instruction: Fill in the correct beginning blend (fl- or fr-) of the picture.

15:learn:5.instruction: Pick a word from the basket, sound out the beginning blend (fl- or fr-), and read the whole word aloud.

16:learn:3.instruction: Color the word that is correctly associated with the image.

16:learn:4.instruction: Choose your favorite shirt from the clothesline, say 'I love this shirt,' and read the word on it loudly for the class to hear.

16:post:4.instruction: Match the pictures with the correct cl- and cr- blend. The first one has been done as an example.

\
